body.zh-CN:
# 当前阶段方法：设计
阅读当前 requirements.md 和相关源码，不重新定义已批准范围。将每个 REQ ID 映射到设计与验证，明确模块职责、数据流、接口、状态、错误处理和兼容影响。
在 design.md 写 Architecture 和 Testing Strategy。只比较真正影响结果的方案，说明选择、代价和为什么不用更复杂方案。区分复用既有概念与仅仅代码相似；选择满足需求的最小设计。验证策略覆盖正常、边界、失败和集成路径，标明真实依赖、环境与无法自动验证项。
只编辑 design.md；禁止 bash 和源码实现。需求需要变化时请用户 /spec revise requirements，不绕过审批。完成后调用 spec_submit；strict 等待人工批准，quick 自动接受本阶段但 tasks/verification 仍需人工批准。
文档顶部的 frontmatter 由扩展按 state.json 自动维护：不要手工编辑，也不要把它当作状态或批准依据。
body.en-US:
# Current stage procedure: design
Read current requirements.md and relevant code without redefining approved scope. Map every REQ ID to design and verification; describe module responsibilities, data flow, interfaces, state, error handling and compatibility impact.
Write Architecture and Testing Strategy in design.md. Compare alternatives only when they change outcomes, explaining the choice, costs and why a more complex option is unnecessary. Distinguish reuse of the same concept from merely similar code; choose the smallest design that meets requirements. Cover normal, boundary, failure and integration paths, real dependencies, required environments and checks that cannot be automated.
Edit only design.md. Bash and source implementation are prohibited. Ask the user for /spec revise requirements if requirements must change. Call spec_submit when finished; strict requires human approval, quick accepts this stage automatically but tasks/verification still require human approval.
The frontmatter block is maintained by the extension from state.json: never edit it by hand and never treat it as state or approval evidence.
